# MatchPlay Ventures

> MatchPlay Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm backing outliers in Life Sciences, FinTech, and Energy. It is part of the MatchPlay Group ecosystem. Website: https://matchplayventures.com/

## How MatchPlay works

- **MatchPlay Group** verifies qualified companies for investor and transaction-readiness. https://www.matchplaygroup.com/
- **MatchPlay Ventures** makes direct investments in early-stage outliers across Life Sciences, FinTech, and Energy, backing conviction bets with capital and hands-on partnership.
- **Capital Partners** is MatchPlay's co-investment network. Accredited investors, family offices, venture funds, angel groups, and strategic investors can invest alongside MatchPlay Ventures, typically through MatchPlay-sponsored SPVs. Participation is optional, deal by deal. https://matchplayventures.com/capital-partners/

## For founders

- Apply for funding: https://app.matchplaygroup.com

## For investors

- Join Capital Partners: https://app.matchplaygroup.com/#/auth/investor-signup

## Portfolio

- [Jeeva Clinical Trials](https://jeevatrials.com/): Unified, FDA-ready digital infrastructure with embedded AI for clinical trials. Investment thesis: https://matchplayventures.com/portfolio/rebuilding-the-operating-system-for-clinical-trials/
- [NeuroVRD](https://www.neurovrd.com/): Sentinel AI-IONM Platform: AI-enabled software that detects the onset of neurovascular irritation during high-risk surgeries. Investment thesis: https://matchplayventures.com/portfolio/bringing-real-time-intelligence-into-the-operating-room/
- [Tenzr Health](https://www.tenzrhealth.com/): Gamified care management platform that helps physical rehab clinics keep patients engaged. Investment thesis: https://matchplayventures.com/portfolio/building-the-engagement-layer-rehabilitation-has-been-missing/
- [Geneial](https://www.geneial.com/): AI-powered, privacy-preserving data platform for precision medicine. Investment thesis: https://matchplayventures.com/portfolio/building-the-data-infrastructure-for-precision-medicine/
- [SOLUtion Medical](https://www.solutionmedco.com/): TwistJECT point-of-care drug mixing platform for emergency treatment of adrenal crisis. Investment thesis: https://matchplayventures.com/portfolio/making-life-saving-drug-delivery-work-in-the-real-world/
- [KBO Systems](https://kbosystems.com/): Perioperative brain monitoring combining multi-region EEG, auditory evoked potentials, and machine learning. Investment thesis: https://matchplayventures.com/portfolio/rethinking-how-we-protect-the-brain-during-anesthesia/
- [Guidant BioTherapeutics](https://www.guidantbio.com/): Clinical-stage immuno-oncology biologics platform for targeted delivery into the tumor microenvironment.
- [3DOS](https://3dorthobio.com/): Customizable, 3D-printed biodegradable scaffolds for bone repair and regeneration. Investment thesis: https://matchplayventures.com/portfolio/teskltjseklkajdlfkajdlfajsdlkjfkldsf/
